column2: sc_* = the START CHATTING tap in completeConnect (budget 10.0s) — the ONLY site this batch varies:
sc_first_look  = tapped on the first look (polls=0)
sc_self_healed = became hittable DURING the poll (polls>0) — late, not lost
sc_timed_out   = never hittable; the fallback tap went out (outcome=tappedAfterTimeout)
the three sum to the number of connect journeys in the bundle (3 today)
the two DEBUG overlay fixtures tap the same button on a SHORTER budget with their
arms pinned in the source; they are excluded from all three and are not this site
